description.zh:
通过集群 ID 过滤

> 这个集群ID不是 ACK 集群ID，而是通过本接口返回的数据里面的 `cluster_id` 字段，或者 ListCluster 接口返回数据中的 `id` 字段。
description.en:
Filter by cluster ID.

> This cluster ID is not the ACK cluster ID, but the `cluster_id` field in the data returned by this API, or the `id` field in the data returned by the ListCluster API.

description.zh: 指定本参数则过滤出指定Agent的安装列表，可以搭配 plugin_version 参数使用
description.en: Specify this parameter to filter the installation list for a specific agent. Can be used in combination with the plugin_version parameter.

description.zh: 不可单独使用，搭配 plugin_id 使用，用于过滤出指定Agent指定版本的安装列表
description.en: Cannot be used alone. Use in combination with plugin_id to filter the installation list for a specific agent version.

title.zh: 获取 ACK 集群组件安装记录
title.en: Get ACK cluster component installation records
